data.why: the repo ships no example B-mode ultrasound image, so a grayscale-ish stock image stands in as an upload target to exercise calibration, AOL contour drawing, and fat-point marking (the exact tissue boundaries will be nonsensical but the UI workflow and math are fully exercised).

goals: upload a B-mode ultrasound image of a carcass cross-section for analysis
calibrate pixel-to-centimeter scale using the scale bar on the image
trace the Longissimus dorsi muscle contour to get its cross-sectional area (AOL/REA)
mark two points across the subcutaneous fat layer to get fat thickness (EGS/BFT)
repeat across a batch of images and export all AOL/EGS results to a single Excel file

review.summary: This tree gets EchoMetrics' purpose exactly: it follows the README's calibrate, trace the loin-eye outline, mark fat thickness workflow for single images and coded batches exported to Excel, and every screen I sampled shows what its node says. Before filing, it needs these fixes: merge the batch phase's per-run sample tasks into one repeated task, set the file-picker quirk apart from cancelling, and add the spreadsheet's columns from the code.
